title: worker scope check ignores shared git ref updates
body:
Outcome: the worker scope check ignores ref updates in the shared common git directory (other lanes' fetch/push under .git/refs/remotes) and reports only worktree paths.
Evidence: t-sa7ag03 worker turn exited 3 "scope violation: .git/refs/remotes/origin/feat/memory-refs" while lane memory pushed #211 during the turn.
Proof: driver observer: a ref written in the common git dir during a turn yields no scope violation; a worktree file outside --allow still exits 3.
